title: E0096: Cookie Without Secure Flag
plain_english: Setting a cookie without the `Secure` flag allows it to be sent over unencrypted HTTP, where it can be intercepted by network attackers.
why_matters: Without the `Secure` flag: - Session cookies can be stolen via network sniffing - Attackers on the same network can capture cookies - Authentication tokens are exposed in transit
what_it_checks: `setcookie()` or `setrawcookie()` calls where `secure` is not set to `true`
